description:
We are actively seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the nursing department at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal leadership role offers a competitive annual salary and the opportunity to significantly impact patient care and staff development. We are looking to fill this role quickly with a passionate and qualified professional.

As the Director of Nursing, you will be responsible for overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring the highest standards of patient care, and fostering a supportive environment for our nursing team. This is an excellent opportunity for a leader committed to clinical excellence and operational efficiency.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa.
Minimum of 2-3 years of nursing leadership experience, preferably in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting.
Strong understanding of state and federal healthcare regulations.
Proven ability to manage and mentor nursing staff.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000 based on experience and qualifications.

description:
Join a dedicated team at a leading healthcare facility in Greenville, SC, as a Family Medicine Physician. This role offers exceptional compensation, starting at a non-negotiable base salary of $210,000 per year, complemented by a robust bonus structure that can reach up to $50,000. This includes a guaranteed $25,000 bonus and an additional $25,000 potential bonus, with $9,000 available on your first payday upon signing a promissory note.

We are seeking highly motivated MDs or DOs specializing in Family Medicine, Internal Medicine, or Med/Ped. While full-time is preferred, we are open to reviewing all physician candidates for consideration, including those seeking part-time, PRN, or contract arrangements. The position also offers great benefits, generous PTO, and support for travel and relocation, making it an ideal opportunity for physicians looking for a dynamic and rewarding environment.
requirements: Doctor of Medicine (MD) or Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine (DO) degree
Board certification or eligibility in Family Medicine (preferred), Internal Medicine, or Med/Ped
salaryOrBonusInfo: Non-negotiable base salary of $210,000 per year, with a potential bonus structure up to $50,000. This includes a guaranteed $25,000 bonus and an additional $25,000 potential bonus, with $9,000 available on payday one (upon signing a promissory note). Relocation/Sign-on bonuses are included in the overall bonus structure. Compensation is significantly above the average for Family MDs in SC.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated Part-time Remote Radiologist with a New York State license to join our team. This role is crucial for reading Musculoskeletal (MSK) imaging, primarily focusing on Workers' Compensation and No-Fault (NF) cases. We offer a unique compensation structure designed to reward your expertise and efficiency.

Candidates must be experienced in handling workers' compensation or NF/Lien cases, as we do not work with major medical insurances, Medicare, or Medicaid. The ability to work weekends is a key requirement for this position. This is an excellent opportunity for a radiologist looking for a flexible, part-time role with a bonus-heavy compensation model.
requirements: Current New York State (NYS) Radiologist license.
Demonstrated experience with Workers' Compensation and No-Fault (NF) cases.
NY WCB (Workers' Compensation Board) number preferred.
salaryOrBonusInfo: This role offers a unique compensation model with a strong emphasis on bonuses. Pay rates are $50 per MRI, $30 per CT, and $10 per X-Ray. Compensation is heavily weighted towards bonuses rather than a fixed salary.
